Ranks 2 and 3 (birthday date personality test, birthday decoration ideas at home) remain HELD on the Phase 0 gate — no first-party data exists for numerology or physical decoration and no first-hand experience substitutes; not authorised for override. publishBlockers.detail: Every Devanagari, Tamil, Gujarati, Telugu, Gurmukhi and Urdu string is machine-generated and unverified. Each post records this as a STRUCTURAL audit failure. birthday-wishes-in-urdu counted its exposure precisely at 14 strings and presented NO verse at all, grounding that refusal in Pritchett & Khaliq's Urdu Meter — unlike the 2026-08-25 rakhi Urdu post, which shipped 7 original shers and is still unpublishable. CORRECTED COUNT: this affects 11 of the 20 posts, not 7 — an earlier count matched only on the phrase 'native reader' and missed posts wording it as 'machine-composed' or 'unverified'. The list here is derived from the audit text AND from an actual Unicode-range scan of each body, so it catches posts carrying script examples without a blocker in failed[].

181 birthday posts are live and none appeared in any of the 60 India SERPs harvested. Striking-distance versus indexing cannot be distinguished without a GSC export, and that determines whether these 20 land in the same hole.
